mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ticket_operation_log ( id, ticket_id, operation_type, from_status, to_status, operator_id, content, request_ip, user_agent, create_by, update_by, deleted ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{ticketId}, #{operationType}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{operatorId}, #{content}, #{requestIp}, #{userAgent}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy}, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT id, ticket_id, operation_type, from_status, to_status, operator_id, content, request_ip, user_agent, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by, deleted FROM ticket_operation_log WHERE ticket_id = #{ticketId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC

SELECT timeline.type, timeline.title, timeline.content, timeline.operator_name, timeline.created_at FROM ( SELECT 'OPERATION' AS type, operation_type AS title, content, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickname, ''), NULLIF(u.username, ''), u.phone, '系统') AS operator_name, l.create_time AS created_at, l.id AS event_id FROM ticket_operation_log l LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = l.operator_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE l.ticket_id = #{ticketId} AND l.deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'COMMENT' AS type, CASE WHEN c.comment_type = 'INTERNAL' THEN '内部备注' ELSE '公开评论' END AS title, c.content, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickname, ''), NULLIF(u.username, ''), u.phone, '未知用户') AS operator_name, c.create_time AS created_at, c.id AS event_id FROM ticket_comment c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = c.author_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE c.ticket_id = #{ticketId} AND c.deleted = 0 AND c.comment_type != 'INTERNAL' UNION ALL SELECT 'ATTACHMENT' AS type, '上传附件' AS title, a.file_name AS content, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickname, ''), NULLIF(u.username, ''), u.phone, '未知用户') AS operator_name, a.create_time AS created_at, a.id AS event_id FROM ticket_attachment a LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = a.uploader_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND ((a.biz_type = 'TICKET' AND a.biz_id = #{ticketId}) OR (a.biz_type = 'COMMENT' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ticket_comment ac WHERE ac.id = a.biz_id AND ac.ticket_id = #{ticketId} AND ac.deleted = 0 AND ac.comment_type != 'INTERNAL' ))) ) timeline ORDER BY timeline.created_at DESC, timeline.event_id DESC
